interpretation_for_current_manuscript.model_observation: Absolute RMSF comparison can localize reduced motion at peptide position 6 and neighboring unmutated positions, especially P7; original model numbers must come from the preserved prediction source table.
interpretation_for_current_manuscript.supported_inference: The lower predicted motion around D6 and adjacent TCR-contact backbone positions is consistent with stronger local constraints in the bound mutant epitope and with the original thermodynamic ordering cost.
do_not_infer: Lower RMSF alone proves stronger affinity
RMSF quantifies binding free energy or electrostatics
Bound-state RMSF comparison measures the entropy change upon binding
The original paper published these peptide RMSF curves
Original 25 × 4 ns MD equals current ITrace 3 × 200 ns MD
WT versus G12D is a before/after time series
interpretation_for_current_manuscript.recommended_emphasis: Model → spatial dynamic pattern → contact-network interpretation → experimental affinity/thermodynamic consistency. MD comparison remains secondary.
